name: Shigeki, Jukai Visionary
oracle_text:
{1}{G}, {T}, Return Shigeki to its owner's hand: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest into your graveyard.
Channel — {X}{X}{G}{G}, Discard this card: Return X target nonlegendary cards from your graveyard to your hand.
blocked_sentences: Channel — {X}{X}{G}{G}, Discard this card: Return X target nonlegendary cards from your graveyard to your hand.

needs.what: An activated ability whose target COUNT is the announced X from its own {X} mana cost (targets: [{count: {"x": true}, kind: card_in_graveyard, ...}]) -- legality must enumerate one activation per payable X with exactly X targets, as it already does for spells (TargetSpec.x_sized via Game._ask_x_sized_targets) and for abilities whose target SELECTOR reads X
needs.why_existing_wont_do: legality._targets_read_x only checks whether a target's selector mentions X (_mentions_x on spec.selector), never spec.count, so an ability with count {"x": true} is enumerated once with targeting.target_count evaluating the count from bindings that carry no x -- it sizes to 0 and the ability always returns nothing. The x_sized path in game.py covers card.targets (spells) only, and no shipped activated ability uses an X-sized target count
